messages:
Alice S: Heads-up: NimbusBank POC hits ~1.2s first-token latency on hosted demo path (model=rwd-3b-v1). They need <300ms for an investor-facing demo tomorrow. Also asked whether a warmup will materially affect their credit usage. Can we triage quick fixes?

Ben (sales): Looping in @Chris Infra and @Dana SE. Demo scheduled 11:00 ET tomorrow. High priority ask: quick list of mitigations + an estimate of token cost for warmup.

Chris Infra: Quick clarifying Qs: are requests streaming? sample prompt size? are requests coming through the SDK or raw HTTP? Also any x-cache headers captured?

Alice S: Sample request (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-3b-v1",
  "input": "Summarize this policy excerpt... (~420 chars)",
  "max_tokens": 150,
  "stream": true
}
```
Also grabbed headers from a run: x-cache: MISS, x-instance-latency: 1.18s, x-routing: hosted-us-east-1

Chris Infra: That header + sample points to two major factors: JIT/kernel compilation + instance cold spin (shared-hosted may scale down). Another thing: check if client batching window is enabled which can add wait time.

Chris Infra: Run this debug query and paste last 10m logs:
```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/debug/requests?since=10m&model=rwd-3b-v1\"
```
Look for entries: \"cache MISS\", \"KERNEL_JIT compile_time=\", \"kv_cache_miss=true\"

Alice S: We pulled logs: 
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 x-cache=MISS kv_cache_miss=true KERNEL_JIT compile_time=340ms instance_spinup=720ms total=1.18s
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 routing=hosted-us-east-1 model=rwd-3b-v1

Dana SE: Confirms diagnosis. Fast mitigations:
- run a short warmup sequence 60-90s before the demo to prime kernel JITs and KV cache
- set prefer_latency=true or use an endpoint with reserved capacity to eliminate instance spin-up jitter
- disable batch window or set batch_window_ms=0 in SDK for demo mode

Dana SE: Warmup example (low token cost):
```bash
for i in {1..6}; do \
  curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
    -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b-v1\",\"input\":\"warmup\",\"max_tokens\":4}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; sleep 5;
done
```
Estimated token usage: ~24 tokens (6 requests * ~4 tokens) + cost of short responses. Negligible for a demo.

Ben (sales): Nimbus is price-sensitive. Can you put that token estimate in writing and mention options for production (Dedicated/reserved)?

Dana SE: Short pricing note: warmup charged at normal per-token rates; tiny warmup bursts (under 100 tokens) cost <$1 at current credits for rwd-3b-v1. For production, Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit) avoids per-request spinups; costs depend on commit size, but gives predictable unit economics and an SLA. I will draft a one-paragraph pricing blurb.

Chris Infra: Also verify client behavior: some SDKs buffer multiple incoming requests into a single batch. For demo set SDK config: batch_window_ms=0 and prefer_latency=true. That will force immediate dispatch.

Alice S: Also, customer completed a security questionnaire. They require SOC2, encryption at rest, and ability to IP allowlist callbacks/webhooks. Can we provide security pack and answers?

Dana SE: We have the security package and a filled questionnaire template. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/docs/security-pkg. @Ben please upload the customer's completed form so I can merge answers.

Ben (sales): Uploading now: https://drive.company/nimbus-soc2-form.pdf

infra-bot: [infra-bot] Canary rollout: rwd-3b-v1 -> v1.1 completed in hosted-us-east-1 at 2026-03-20T13:50:00Z; no errors reported.

Chris Infra: Action items (short):
- Dana: draft pricing blurb + security answers (ETA 2h)
- Alice: run warmup commands on the customer's test key and confirm x-cache: HIT before demo
- Ben: attach customer questionnaire and involve legal for IP allowlist

Alice S: Running warmup now, will report back with headers.

Ben (sales): Nimbus wants warmup automated on demo start. Is there a Console job we can schedule?

Dana SE: Yes Console -> Jobs -> Warmup supports one-off scheduled warmups. I can also provide a runnable script if they prefer.

Alice S: Warmup executed. New headers: x-cache: HIT. Measured TTFT on two checks: ~240ms. Customer satisfied for demo.

Chris Infra: Nice. Follow-up suggestion: if Nimbus moves forward, propose a small Dedicated canary (e.g., 30k/mo commit) to guarantee <200ms at scale.

Ben (sales): Proceeding with procurement. Dana, please attach pricing and security artifacts to CRM and tag legal.

Dana SE: Will attach and assign owner.

Alice S: Thanks all :thumbsup:
